name: Assmann WSW Components Inc.
old_description: The product range on standard- and customer tailored connectors of ASSMANN WSW not only convincing by the major variety of different products for so many different applications, but as well by offering appropriate quality, technology and prices in line with market requirements. The big number of standard products, which have been adopted to customer specific requirements and the continuous extension of the product range with new customer tailored connector-systems, show clearly, how important terms like "flexibility" and "customer relation" are for ASSMANN WSW and their success on the market.
about:
Assmann WSW Components Inc. operates from Phoenix, Arizona, as the U.S. subsidiary of the German connector specialist Assmann WSW components GmbH. The company provides a broad portfolio of standard and custom interconnect solutions from its Phoenix facility.

Its product range spans thousands of connector part numbers across categories including board-to-board, wire-to-board, wire-to-wire, circular, D-SUB, DIN, USB, FFC/FPC, modular, and micro-miniature connectors, as well as terminal blocks, IC sockets, and battery connectors. The company also supplies thermal management components and customized cable assemblies. Standard offerings cover pin counts from 1 to 100, contact spacings from 0.3 mm to 17 mm, current ratings up to 65 A, and termination styles such as crimp, IDC, press-fit, surface mount, through-hole reflow, solder cup, and wire wrap.

The input does not identify specific industries or customer types; the company's connector and cable assembly products are generally suited for electronics manufacturers across multiple sectors.

Assmann WSW emphasizes flexibility and customer relation as keys to its market success, highlighting a continuous expansion of its standard product range and the adaptation of standard items to customer-specific requirements, all while maintaining quality, technology, and pricing aligned with market demands.
